description.en: A basic construction material for masonry or reinforced concrete work. The grade, size or intended mix helps estimate quantities without treating every foundation task as the same. This listing is for washed construction sand for mortar and concrete, compact pack for residential repairs.

Este anúncio apresenta areia lavada para argamassa e concreto, embalagem compacta para reparos residenciais.
